title: The Grand Aranya Villa
tagline: A sprawling 4,200 sq.ft contemporary duplex with warm stone cantilever facades and natural cross-lighting.
excerpt: A masterfully crafted two-storey luxury duplex featuring floor-to-ceiling glass expanses, textured stone louvers, and bespoke teak interior joinery.
overview: Situated along the green corridor of Indore's Bypass, The Grand Aranya Villa was commissioned by a leading medical family seeking an enduring generational sanctuary. The architectural brief demanded maximum natural light, complete acoustic privacy from the road, and an expansive ground-floor court that merges the living salon with landscaped gardens.
architectureStory: Our design and civil team engineered an asymmetric cantilevered facade using Fe-550D structural steel framing. The upper terrace floats gracefully above the lower veranda, clad in natural beige travertine stone and weather-shielded charred timber battens. Large western elevations feature motorized thermal double-glazed apertures that welcome golden evening light while preventing solar heat gain during peak Central Indian summers.

title: Suman Nagar Contemporary Residence
tagline: An urban modern residence engineered for compact city plots, featuring private lightwells and vertical green courts.
excerpt: Smart spatial planning turns an urban 1,500 sq.ft footprint into an airy, four-bedroom family home with private rooftop recreation.
overview: Urban construction in established colonies like Suman Nagar requires meticulous site logistics, silent execution, and innovative spatial engineering. The homeowner required 4 spacious bedrooms, a home office, and two covered car parking bays within an urban 1,500 sq.ft plot without compromising on greenery or ventilation.
architectureStory: We solved the spatial constraint through an open-plan central spine centered on a vertical lightwell. By stepping the upper floor back from the street front, we created a private landscaped terrace balcony that shields bedrooms from street noise while providing a sweeping morning view toward the Indore skyline.

title: The Onyx Commercial Arcade
tagline: A high-visibility corporate commercial landmark with clear-span retail floors and a structural curtain wall facade.
excerpt: Engineered for high footfall commercial tenants, offering column-free floor plates, high-speed elevator wells, and energy-efficient double glazing.
overview: Commissioned by an institutional investor in the bustling Vijay Nagar commercial district, The Onyx was planned as a multi-tenant retail and executive clinic complex. The project demanded rapid construction turnaround, maximum rentable floor efficiency, and a facade that captivates vehicular traffic day and night.
architectureStory: Shivom Builders executed deep foundation pile casting and post-tensioned floor slabs that eradicated intermediate columns across the retail floors. The exterior facade employs a high-performance structural spider-glazing system with Saint-Gobain sun-ban blue glass, coupled with dark charcoal aluminum composite panels.

title: Mayank Blue Commercial & Leisure Complex

overview: Developing leisure and water-focused properties requires specialized civil engineering. The project required commercial water retaining structures, massive paved plazas, food courts, and changing pavilion complexes.

The surrounding hospitality structures were planned with airy colonial-modern verandas that shield guests from direct sun while encouraging breeze circulation.

title: Vasant Vihar Minimalist Duplex
tagline: A serene 3,100 sq.ft family home characterized by clean horizontal lines, warm sandstone screens, and double-height living.
excerpt: A contemporary duplex in one of Indore's quietest residential neighborhoods, prioritizing natural wood, sandstone, and garden courtyards.
overview: The client desired a peaceful retreat away from urban bustle—a home defined by subtle sophistication rather than flashy ornamentation. They requested open-plan ground floor living, an airy puja pavilion, and private bedroom suites on the first level.
architectureStory: The home features an exposed concrete textured feature wall balanced against warm sandstone jali screens. The double-height living room acts as the thermal lung of the home, expelling warm air through high-level clerestory louvers while drawing cool garden air inward.

title: The Shivalik Luxury Bungalow
tagline: An expansive 5,000 sq.ft private estate with wraparound landscaped verandas and artisan stone masonry.
excerpt: Crafted for an industrialist family on a corner estate plot, combining classical proportion with modern glass and steel pavilion living.
overview: Set along the prestigious Super Corridor development corridor, this private residence was envisioned as a permanent heritage home. The sprawling plot provided the canvas for a dual-wing layout separating guest entertainment suites from private family living quarters.
architectureStory: Shivom Builders executed the entire structure using custom-formed architectural concrete and hand-chiselled local MP sandstone. The private rear courtyard houses a reflection pool and pergolas designed for family gatherings.
